messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: ExonRmaPlm patch for affyPLM/preprocessCore version issues available
parts:
Hi,

if you're working with exon arrays, a patch for ExonRmaPlm is
available that addresses the recent affyPLM/preprocessCore version
issues. Just do the following once, and it will be applied whenever
you load the package and until the next version is released:

library(aroma.affymetrix)
downloadPackagePatch("aroma.affymetrix")

Cheers

Henrik

parts:
Hi,

thanks for letting me know. It is not often I do a complete
reinstallation from a fresh R installation, so I tend to miss things
like these. I have to run now, but try

source("http://www.braju.com/R/hbLite.R")
hbLite("R.utils")

It is strange, because the file specifying what version is available is

http://www.braju.com/R/repos/PACKAGES

and that lists R.utils v0.9.7 so I don't know where v0.9.6 is picked
up from. Maybe it is conflict with CRAN where I haven't uploaded
v0.9.6 yet.

What version of R are running - FYI, the R v2.6.0 release is out (BioC
will follow soon).

Also, the patch for ExonRmaPlm is included in the new version of the
package, so it won't be downloaded/installed any longer.

Hope this helps

Henrik
